title: Simple Round Coaster
name: Simple Round Coaster
subtitle: Beginner Crochet Pattern
tagline: Free crochet pattern | Beginner friendly | Printable
seoTitle: Easy Crochet Coaster Pattern for Beginners (Free, Printable) | Crochet Tracker
description: A free, easy round crochet coaster pattern for beginners, worked in double crochet in about 20 minutes. Five rounds with stitch counts. Printable.
lead: A flat circle in double crochet that works up in about 20 minutes. Cotton yarn makes it absorbent and heat-friendly. Make a set in different colours.
yarn: DK or worsted cotton, about 10 g
materialsTable: DK or worsted cotton, about 10 g
notes: Rounds are joined with a slip stitch to the top of the starting chain.
The ch 3 at the start of each round counts as the first dc.

rounds.text: ch 3 (counts as dc), 11 dc in mr, sl st to top of ch 3
ch 3, dc in same st, 2 dc in each st around, sl st to join
ch 3, 2 dc in next st, (dc, 2 dc in next st) x11, sl st to join
ch 3, dc in next st, 2 dc in next st, (dc in next 2 sts, 2 dc in next st) x11, sl st to join
ch 1, sc in each st around, sl st to first sc. Fasten off and weave in ends.

variations: If your coaster ruffles, your stitches are a little loose. Try a 3.5 mm hook. If it cups upward, try a 4.5 mm hook.
